messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 502/504 + client timeouts detected at edge (EU-WEST + partial APAC). Error rate 5xx+timeouts ~7% over last 3m. Paging @maya (oncall). See summary: spike began 2025-08-03T03:33Z.
maya (oncall): on it. joining now, starting quick blast radius. which routes?
jason (eng-sre): main affected route `/v1/generate` on api-gw-eu, small surge on `/v1/embed` as well. upstream `model-proxy` is returning 502s intermittently.
lee (eng-runtime): telemetry shows increased 502s coincident with 95th latency jump and a lot of upstream connection resets. looks like connection pool exhaustion + retry amplification.
maya (oncall): copying runbook: `runbook/ingress-5xx-triage` - first actions: (1) confirm client retry loops, (2) check upstream pod restarts, (3) consider short traffic cutover.
anna (prod-ops): customer-facing impact: ~40 customers affected, mostly small A/B tests; two enterprise customers report errors on short requests. CS informed.
bryan (support): tagging affected tickets 4523,4527. customers seeing `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Time-out`.
jason (eng-sre): quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n prod model-proxy -o wide` shows 3/6 pods in `CrashLoopBackOff` on eu-west cluster. logs show `upstream reset while reading response`.
lee (eng-runtime): pasted a grep snippet from logs:
```
ERROR model-proxy: upstream response truncated: connection reset by peer, len=0
WARN kv-cache: dropped prefix entries due to mem pressure
```

maya (oncall): run `curl -v` to gateway:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-prod.eu/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
> Server: openresty
> X-Request-ID: r-5a3c
```

jason (eng-sre): netstat on gateway frontends shows many TIME_WAIT and established sockets nearing ulimit. suspect short-lived client concurrency + aggressive retries.
lee (eng-runtime): telemetry-bot, can you post upstream error histogram?
telemetry-bot: upstream `model-proxy` 502s spiked from baseline 0.2% -> 9% between 03:32Z and 03:36Z; p50 latency unchanged, p95 doubled. Source IP distribution: many clients from same CDN edge causing uneven fanout.
maya (oncall): initial mitigations: (A) enable global circuit-breaker on `model-proxy` at 30rps to prevent cascade, (B) enable short-circuit fallback to `small-1` model variant for routes where acceptable, (C) temporarily increase `model-proxy` replicas to 8, (D) throttle downstream retries via ingress knob.
anna (prod-ops): rolling restart of bad pods will be visible to customers for ~10s, ok to proceed?
bryan (support): yes proceed, callout to affected customers done. add note to status page.
jason (eng-sre): executing: `kubectl scale deploy/model-proxy -n prod --replicas=8` and flipping circuit-breaker in runtime console.
lee (eng-runtime): after scale we should also bump conn pool size in gateway config from 100 -> 400 for eu nodes. applying now via feature flag.
maya (oncall): applying ingress throttle rule to reject >5req/s per client for 10m to cut retry amplification.
telemetry-bot: scale completed at 03:38Z, circuit-breaker enabled at 03:39Z, throttle rule active 03:40Z.
jason (eng-sre): observing 5xx down to ~1.1% within 2m of mitigation. p95 latency recovering.
lee (eng-runtime): rolling restart completed for 6 pods, two had OOM exit; investigating memory regression in latest model-proxy image. rolling back to previous tag as precaution.
maya (oncall): rollback started `image:model-proxy:2025.07.28` -> expected quick stabilization.
anna (prod-ops): status update posted to status.redwood.ai. customers with high SLAs notified via email.
bryan (support): updating tickets with mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery ~30m.
telemetry-bot: post-mitigation snapshot: 5xx now 0.9%, timeouts 0.7%, overall error budget impact within threshold.
maya (oncall): next steps: (1) root cause: likely model-proxy memory regression + retry storm from certain CDN edge, (2) create follow-up ticket to add better upstream backpressure + circuit-breaker tuning, (3) schedule postmortem if customer impact >1h or >3 enterprise customers. I'll hand off to jason for RCA.
jason (eng-sre): ack, will take RCA lead. collecting logs and heap dumps from model-proxy pods and correlating with client IP fanout.
lee (eng-runtime): propose long-term: autoscale conn pool, more graceful draining, add token-bucket on gateway to smooth spikes.
maya (oncall): thanks team. stand down from pager in 20m if telemetry stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rates returned to baseline. Please file follow-up and assign to eng-runtime/jason for RCA.
